claims: Vandenberg Space Force Base is located on the California coast.
Vandenberg Space Force Base frequently hosts SpaceX Falcon 9 and other rocket launches to place satellites into polar or sun-synchronous orbits.
Recent launches include Starlink missions and defense payloads.
Upcoming launches are scheduled for April 2026 and June 2026.
SpaceX Starlink launches in April 2026 use SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets carrying Starlink satellites to orbit.
SDA Tranche 1 Tracking Layer launch in Q2 2026 uses SpaceX Falcon 9 for the Space Development Agency targeting polar orbit.
Firefly Alpha Block 2 launch in June 2026 is planned for Firefly Aerospace.
STP-S29A Mission launched successfully on April 7, 2026.
STP-S29A Mission used a Northrop Grumman Minotaur IV rocket.
STP-S29A Mission carried U.S. Space Force experiments.
Many launches are visible throughout Santa Barbara, Ventura, and San Luis Obispo counties.
Some launches are visible from as far as Arizona.
Official updates are available from the Vandenberg Space Force Base Facebook page.
Vandenberg Space Force Base's location allows rockets to fly south over the ocean bypassing inhabited areas for polar orbit launches.
Rockets from Vandenberg Space Force Base launch satellites for defense and weather tracking.
